# Marco Montalto Monella

> Personal website and blog of Marco Montalto Monella, a software engineer and multidisciplinary builder based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Currently at Pure Storage, formerly a Production Engineer on Core Data at Meta. Studied at NYU, Stanford, and Politecnico di Torino.

Marco believes he can build anything tech, from large-scale software to hardware (sharpening his analog craft by learning wood carving on the side). Above all he has an insatiable desire to learn, and loves teaching and mentoring others. Beyond engineering he teaches handstands and yoga sculpt, is writing his first book, and is a passionate chef who invests in and advises Nonna Gnocchi because he believes in Italian cuisine. He cares about innovation, health, and the environment, and stays active with gymnastics, beach volleyball, and running.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mmmarco.com/): Overview of who Marco is, what drives him, his journey, and how to get in touch.
- [Blog](https://mmmarco.com/blog/): Thoughts on software engineering, technology, and life.
- [Contact](https://mmmarco.com/contact/): Contact form for getting in touch.

## Blog posts

- [How Claude Rebuilt This Website](https://mmmarco.com/post/how-claude-rebuilt-this-website/): The story of how I teamed up with an AI assistant to redesign and modernize my personal website from scratch.
